title: Use real profile photo and brand logo
context: Replace placeholder identity visuals with real assets by using public/profile.webp in the hero and public/favicon.png as the navbar brand mark.

tasks.title: Wire profile image and navbar favicon logo
acceptance_criteria: HeroSection renders a real profile image sourced from /profile.webp instead of the placeholder SVG initials
Profile image keeps the existing hero avatar styling hook (`hero__avatar`) and removes the old placeholder SVG/initials markup
Navbar brand mark uses /favicon.png as an image asset instead of text initials
Accessibility is preserved: decorative navbar logo remains hidden from screen readers and hero image has descriptive alt text
Focused tests cover hero profile image and navbar brand logo rendering
npx vitest run src/components/__tests__/HeroSection.spec.ts src/__tests__/App.spec.ts, npm run type-check, and npm run build-only all pass
